text: こどもの　くせに　おまえの　ポケモン　ずいぶん　なついているな

structure.en: even though you're just a kid

structure.jp: おまえの　ポケモン
ずいぶん　なついているな

patterns.name: 〜くせに
patterns.explanation: くせに means 'even though', said with a sneer, as if the person has no right to it. こどもの くせに = 'even though you're just a kid'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb here shows a state that has come about and stays. なついている = 'they are attached to you'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker is struck by something, like 'sure' or 'huh'. なついているな = 'they sure are attached'.
